serving.system_prompt: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
serving.notes: The card's example does not use the chat template. It tokenizes a raw prompt and calls generate with max_new_tokens=5 and do_sample=False. The template's default system line is the stock Qwen sentence. config.json and generation_config.json set max length 32768. The safetensors header reports 1,543,714,304 BF16 parameters. There is no adapter_config.json. The card does not say the LoRA was merged. Step 5600 is the checkpoint selected by lowest eval loss, not a stated total step count. The Hub MedMCQA train split has 182,822 rows; the official validation split has 4,183 rows. The card evaluates 2,816 single-choice validation questions. No paper or GitHub repository names this repository id.

evaluation_reported.text: On 2,816 single-choice MedMCQA validation questions, this model scores 42.5% accuracy. The card estimates the untuned base at about 39% and a random baseline at 25%. Subject accuracies: Biochemistry 60.7% (122), Pathology 51.4% (259), Pharmacology 49.2% (179), Pediatrics 48.9% (133), Physiology 46.6% (133), Microbiology 45.9% (74), Medicine 44.9% (185), Gynaecology & Obstetrics 42.2% (154), Surgery 41.4% (249), Dental 37.0% (845), Anatomy 35.4% (147).
